# agentic-spreadsheet

Spreadsheets with formulas that people and agents edit together.

Keywords: spreadsheet,sheets,formulas,grid,collaboration,agents,mcp,cli,csv,xlsx.

- SDK: import { Workbook } from "agentic-spreadsheet".
- CLI and MCP: planned.
